statement.title: Reduction of $B_0$ to $256$ gates
statement.full_tex: Let $A$ be a non-third-level normal form with $T$-factor $T_{p_A}$, and $B_0=\Pi_\rho\,i^{g}T_{p_A}$ with $g:\F_2^3\to\Z/4$ and $\rho$ affine or affinely equivalent to $\pi$ of Lemma~\ref{app:return-block}\textup{(4)}. Let $\rho_0$ be the identity, and for $0\ne k\in\F_2^3$ let $\rho_k=\lambda_k^{-1}\pi\lambda_k$ with $\lambda_k$ linear and $\lambda_k(k)=(0,0,1)$. Modulo left multiplication by monomial Clifford gates, $B_0$ is one of the $256$ gates $\Pi_{\rho_k}\,i^{axy+bxz+cyz+dxyz}\,T_{p_A}$ with $k\in\F_2^3$, $a,b,c\in\F_2$ and $d\in\Z/4$, or $\rho(x+k)+\rho(x)$ does not depend on $x$ exactly for $k\in\{0,(1,1,1)\}$, and then some $B_0P_vA^\dagger\notin\C_3(3)$.

finite_domain: The 10,752 permutations affine or affinely equivalent to pi; all g: F_2^3 -> Z/4 modulo diagonal Clifford phases; the 20 non-third-level cores.

covered_subclaims: Every permutation lies in a left affine coset of one of eight listed ones; the 32 listed phases represent all classes for the identity and the six other radical directions and 16 for (1,1,1), where a non-third-level B_0 P_v A^dagger is found; the 360 common-input pairs are recomputed.

remaining_work: No verifier of supplied evidence separate from the recomputation.

checker_conventions: paper/conventions.json; each checker states its coordinate order in its docstring
